events.summary: Speaker A set the goal: a remote control that is new and original, trendy and user friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it should be, of course, new and original, and um it should be trendy, and user friendly

events.summary: Speaker A said the remote will be sold for 25 EUR.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we want to sell uh this remote control for twenty five Euro Euro

events.summary: Speaker A gave the expected profit as around 50000000 EUR.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: our expected profit will be around fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker A set the maximum production cost at 12.50 EUR per unit.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: a production cost of maximum uh twelve point fifty Euro

events.summary: Speaker A decided to target a worldwide market, not only Switzerland.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we are trying to to have a market all around the world

events.summary: Speaker D said remotes have too many small buttons, when people use only four or six, so the remote should have fewer buttons.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: on a T_V_ remote you only ever use, mostly, you know, f four or f six buttons

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a backlight for use in the dark, possibly switched on by the room light level.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it's probably worth to to have something like uh back light

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a potentiometer or slider for volume instead of two discrete buttons.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: But I prefer like a potential-meter or something like

events.summary: Speaker A objected that a slider could move by accident, so the volume could jump up quickly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Are you not afraid that if you take your remote control you can move the slide

events.summary: Speaker A objected that a loud volume on a slider could surprise the user when picking the remote up from the table.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: you take it and you push the button and everything is very loud

events.summary: Speaker C proposed radio waves instead of infra-red, since infra-red must be aimed and needs no obstacles.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: I prefer um remote control working with radio waves

events.summary: Speaker A assigned Speaker C to work on the remote design and start new ideas.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the interface interface developer will work on the on the design of the remote control

events.summary: Speaker A committed Speaker C to work on the technical functions of the remote.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: you are going to work on the technical functions of the remote control

events.summary: Speaker A committed Speaker D, the marketing expert, to find the user requirements for the remote.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: you are going to try to to find the user requirements f uh for the remote control
